title: How Lovely Is Your Dwelling Place
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a group of Israelite pilgrims travels along a winding road toward a sanctuary in the hills. The travelers are dressed in practical wool and linen garments, carrying small bags, walking staffs, and water jars. One family pauses beneath a tree where birds nest among the branches, a natural detail recalling the sparrow finding a home near the LORD's altar. As the road rises, the sanctuary becomes visible in the distance, and the pilgrims' tired expressions change to anticipation. Along the route, the landscape transitions from a dry valley into a place refreshed by seasonal rain, with small plants growing around watercourses. This symbolizes the blessedness of those whose strength is in God and whose hearts are set on the pilgrimage. The image should express longing for God's courts and the joy of traveling toward His presence, without resembling modern religious tourism. Ancient architecture, realistic bird nests, natural terrain, and soft morning light. No modern backpacks, paved roads, text, or fantasy effects.

title: A Day in Your Courts Is Better Than a Thousand
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an Israelite pilgrim arrives at a modest sanctuary courtyard after a long journey. He sets down his walking staff and water jar, then bows his head in prayer, expressing longing to remain in God's presence. Several worshippers sit in the shaded courtyard while musicians prepare a song. A doorkeeper stands respectfully near the entrance, illustrating the psalm's declaration that even a lowly position in God's house is preferable to the comforts of wickedness elsewhere. Outside the courtyard, the sun lights a broad landscape of homes, fields, and distant hills, symbolizing God's provision as sun and shield. The pilgrim's face reflects contentment and gratitude rather than disappointment in ordinary life. Use historically plausible stone architecture, woven curtains, modest furnishings, realistic clothing, and natural light. Avoid depicting an elaborate later temple if the setting is intended to reflect an earlier Israelite sanctuary. No modern objects, readable captions, or supernatural effects.

title: Restore Us Again, O God of Our Salvation
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient Israelite community begins rebuilding parts of a settlement after a season of hardship. Some residents repair a damaged stone wall, others clear a courtyard, and a family restores the roof of a modest house. An elder stands near the sanctuary, leading the people in prayer as they remember God's past favor, forgiveness, and restoration of their land. Their expressions convey gratitude mixed with continued concern, because they still need renewed mercy and salvation. In the distance, fields show both damaged areas and small signs of fresh growth after rainfall. The visual should express the prayer that God turn away from anger, revive His people, and let them rejoice again. Avoid depicting a complete, instantaneous restoration or a specific historical return from exile unless the context is explicitly established. Historically plausible tools, stonework, garments, and natural light. No modern construction equipment, text, or fantasy effects.

title: Mercy and Truth Have Met Together
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism with gentle symbolic composition. In an ancient Israelite village, two neighbors meet at a doorway after resolving a long disagreement. One offers a hand in peace, while the other responds with sincere respect. Nearby, an elder listens to a truthful account of a dispute, and a poor family receives fair treatment. In the background, clouds begin to clear over a field as soft rain nourishes the soil and new growth appears among the plants. The landscape evokes the psalm's imagery of mercy and truth meeting, righteousness and peace embracing, truth springing from the earth, and righteousness looking down from heaven. These qualities should be communicated through human reconciliation and healthy land rather than literal figures representing virtues. The scene should feel hopeful but grounded, showing that peace and righteousness are linked to God's faithful presence. Historically plausible clothing, stone houses, agricultural details, and natural daylight. No modern objects, written labels, or fantasy effects.

title: Bow Down Your Ear, O LORD
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, David kneels in a quiet stone courtyard in ancient Jerusalem, bringing a humble plea to God. His clothing is simple, and his hands are raised as he asks to be heard because he is poor, needy, and dependent on divine mercy. A small oil lamp and clay water vessel sit beside him, while an open doorway reveals the stillness of the street outside. His expression is earnest and trusting, showing that he calls upon God throughout the day and believes the LORD is ready to forgive and abundant in steadfast love. In a separate part of the courtyard, a child and an elderly neighbor wait near the entrance, representing ordinary people who also need kindness and support. The image should convey David's humility and repeated prayer without depicting an actual supernatural reply. Historically plausible Israelite garments, woven mats, limestone architecture, and warm natural light. No modern furnishings, readable text, or fantasy effects.

title: You Alone Are God
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a hilltop courtyard in ancient Jerusalem where David stands in prayer and looks out toward the surrounding lands. Distant travelers and settlements occupy the valleys, suggesting the psalm's vision that all nations will come to worship and glorify God. Nearby, people from several regions gather with respectful expressions, each wearing historically plausible clothing from the ancient Near East. David gestures upward and toward the broad horizon, acknowledging the uniqueness of the LORD's works and asking to be taught God's way so that he may walk in truth with an undivided heart. The sun illuminates the city walls and nearby hills, while a shaded path leads down into the valley. Avoid depicting God as a visible human figure or making the nations look like a modern international conference. Realistic stonework, natural light, authentic robes. No modern flags, text, or fantasy effects.

title: You, O Lord, Are a God Full of Compassion
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, David stands within the shelter of a stone gatehouse while hostile men gather across the street, speaking arrogantly and threatening him. David does not confront them; instead, he lifts his eyes in prayer and recalls the LORD's compassion, grace, patience, and abundant truth. An older companion places a reassuring hand on David's shoulder, expressing human solidarity without claiming to replace divine help. Beyond the gate, the sky clears and a ray of natural morning light falls on the road, symbolizing the requested sign of God's favor and strengthening presence. The opponents remain distant, and no injury or confrontation occurs. A small household in the background continues its morning work, showing that ordinary life persists amid danger. The panel should express the request for mercy, strength, and deliverance while maintaining a tone of trust rather than revenge. Ancient Israelite garments, stone walls, wooden doors, and realistic light. No modern objects, visible divine figure, graphic violence, or fantasy effects.

title: Glorious Things Are Spoken of Zion
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a panoramic view of ancient Zion rising above the surrounding hills, with stone walls, modest dwellings, and a sanctuary visible near the summit. At the city gate, travelers from different regions arrive and are welcomed into a gathering of worshippers. Their clothing, head coverings, and travel goods suggest varied origins within the ancient Near East without assigning modern national identities. An elder welcomes a traveler and gestures toward the city, expressing the city's honor as the place associated with God. Nearby, musicians prepare lyres and hand drums while families gather to sing. The scene should express the psalm's vision of peoples being recognized as belonging to the city of God and the joy of those who find their source in Him. Avoid presenting this as a literal census or a modern multicultural celebration. Use historically plausible architecture, ancient garments, realistic terrain, and clear daylight. No modern signs, flags, musical equipment, or fantasy effects.

title: My Soul Is Full of Troubles
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a solitary Israelite worshipper sits in a dim stone room, praying through an extended season of grief and distress. His head is bowed, his hands are clasped, and his eyes show exhaustion after repeated nights of asking God to hear him. A small oil lamp casts weak light across a woven mat and clay water vessel. Through the narrow doorway, the streets of the ancient town are quiet and distant, while the worshipper remains physically separated from other people. He does not appear injured, and no specific illness is invented. His isolation is conveyed through the empty room, the deep shadows, and the way he struggles to raise his head toward the sky. The mood must honor the psalm's unrelieved lament without forcing a cheerful resolution that the passage does not provide. Historically plausible clothing, rough stone, realistic lamp light, and restrained facial expression. No modern objects, graphic details, or fantasy effects.

title: O LORD, Why Do You Cast Me Away?
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, the same Israelite worshipper remains alone in the modest dwelling as night approaches. He sits near the doorway, looking toward the fading light over the rooftops of an ancient settlement. A distant neighbor closes a wooden door, while another family gathers indoors, underscoring the worshipper's feeling that companions and familiar people have become distant. His hands remain open in prayer as he asks whether the dead rise to praise God and why he continues to experience affliction and abandonment. These questions should be presented as part of the psalm's anguished lament, not as a literal view of an underworld. The scene should end without an artificial visual breakthrough, because the psalm itself concludes in darkness and unresolved sorrow. Keep the portrayal compassionate, dignified, and non-graphic, with realistic ancient garments, clay lamps, limestone walls, and subdued moonlight. No modern objects, text, or supernatural figures.

title: I Will Sing of the Mercies of the LORD
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a royal singer sits on a stone terrace overlooking ancient Jerusalem, composing a song of thanksgiving to the LORD. He holds a lyre and looks toward the sky, reflecting on God's steadfast love and faithfulness through all generations. Beside him rests a parchment scroll and a simple writing tool, suggesting the preservation of the song. Below the terrace, families move through the city, elders speak at the gate, and children play near a courtyard, conveying the continuity of generations. In the distance, a royal residence rises above ordinary homes, representing the covenant promise made to David that his descendants and throne would endure. The scene should communicate the confidence of the opening verses without implying that every later event will be easy or uninterrupted. Use historically plausible Israelite architecture, ancient musical instruments, linen and wool garments, and warm natural light. No modern writing materials, printed music, or fantasy effects.

title: The Heavens Praise God's Faithfulness
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism with a majestic view of the ancient Near Eastern landscape beneath a broad, star-filled sky. David stands on a rocky ridge outside Jerusalem, contemplating the heavens and the sea in quiet reverence. Beyond the hills, a great body of water stretches toward the horizon, while powerful mountains rise inland. The natural grandeur expresses the psalm's celebration of God's faithfulness in heaven, His unmatched power over the sea, and His sovereignty over creation. In the foreground, a small group of worshippers gathers around a simple lyre player, singing in praise. A sturdy city wall in the distance symbolizes protection, while the sky remains much larger than any human structure. Avoid depicting God as a physical warrior or turning the sea into a fantasy monster. The scene should communicate righteousness and justice as the foundation of divine rule, with steadfast love and truth accompanying Him. Realistic stars, waves, mountain terrain, ancient clothing, and natural moonlight. No modern objects, captions, or supernatural beings.

title: Blessed Is the People Who Know the Joyful Sound
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient Israelite community gathers in a courtyard during a festival of thanksgiving. Musicians sound traditional instruments, and worshippers respond with joyful faces and raised hands. A royal representative stands nearby while elders, families, farmers, and children participate together, reflecting the blessing of a people who know the joyful sound and walk in the light of God's presence. Beyond the courtyard, the walls of Jerusalem and the surrounding hills glow in late-afternoon light. The mood should convey gladness, confidence, and gratitude for God's favor rather than political triumphalism. In a quiet corner, an elder speaks with a younger person about the LORD as the glory and strength of His people and the defender of the king. Use historically plausible instruments, simple royal garments, stone architecture, woven awnings, and natural light. No modern concert equipment, flags, written captions, or fantasy effects.

title: God's Covenant with David
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient Israelite royal court in which a prophet or respected elder speaks to David about God's covenant and the promise of an enduring royal line. David stands humbly before the speaker, wearing a simple royal mantle rather than an extravagant crown. Around them, trusted attendants and military leaders listen in silence. Through open arches, the city of Jerusalem and distant hills are visible, suggesting the territory over which David's descendants are expected to rule. A young attendant watches David carefully, symbolizing the passing of responsibility to future generations. The scene should communicate the covenant language of God's promise to establish David's seed, uphold him, and remain faithful even while correcting wrongdoing. Do not show a visible divine figure dictating a document or suggest that the covenant guarantees every descendant will act faithfully. Use plausible ancient royal furnishings, parchment, stone architecture, and natural light. No modern thrones, European medieval crowns, readable text, or fantasy effects.

title: The Crown Cast Down and the King Humbled
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient Israelite city after a period of military defeat and political humiliation. The royal courtyard is quiet, the city gate shows damage, and the king sits without his outer mantle, looking troubled as advisers gather around him. A plain crown rests on a low wooden table, symbolizing the shame described in the psalm's lament that the LORD's anointed appears rejected and his throne brought low. In the surrounding streets, families carry belongings toward safer dwellings, and elders look out from the city wall at a road where foreign troops have passed. No bodies or graphic injuries are shown. The composition should not claim a specific siege unless the text identifies one. The mood is grief, confusion, and a plea for God to remember the covenant, not a declaration that the covenant has permanently ended. Historically plausible ancient Israelite architecture, garments, royal furnishings, and muted natural light. No modern ruins, graphic violence, or fantasy effects.

title: How Long, O LORD? Remember the Reproach of Your Servants
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an older Israelite worshipper stands near the walls of a diminished ancient city, looking toward the sky in solemn prayer. The royal residence behind him appears subdued, and the city streets are quieter than in earlier scenes. He asks how long the LORD's anger will remain and remembers the brevity of human life, with generations passing through the same streets. A small group of families gathers near a doorway, listening as the elder expresses sorrow over the insult directed toward God's servants and the humiliation of the king. The composition should include both personal grief and concern for the covenant community, ending with the continued blessing of the LORD rather than an invented visual resolution. A thin line of warm light rests on the upper city wall, offering restrained hope without implying that restoration has already occurred. Use authentic ancient clothing, weathered stone, natural late-afternoon light, and realistic expressions. No modern objects, readable text, graphic details, or fantasy effects.

title: From Everlasting to Everlasting, You Are God
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a vast mountain landscape in the ancient Near East, where rocky peaks rise above a fertile valley and an old settlement sits beside a stream. In the foreground, an elderly Israelite rests beside a tree whose trunk is weathered and whose roots extend into the earth. Nearby, a child plays in the grass, making the passing of generations visible in one scene. The landscape should convey the contrast between God's everlasting existence and the brevity of human life, like grass that flourishes in the morning and fades by evening. The sky moves from the pale light of early morning to shadows across distant slopes, creating a subtle sense of time passing without a literal time-lapse effect. An elder stands quietly and looks toward the mountains, reflecting on God as the people's dwelling place through all generations. Historically plausible ancient clothing, natural vegetation, realistic terrain, and soft light. No modern watches, clocks, text, or fantasy effects.

title: Teach Us to Number Our Days
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an Israelite family gathers near a stone dwelling as evening approaches. An elder sits with younger relatives and speaks soberly about the shortness of life, the seriousness of wrongdoing, and the need for wisdom. His face is thoughtful rather than fearful. In the background, people finish the day's work: a farmer brings tools indoors, a shepherd returns with the flock, and a mother prepares a simple meal. Their ordinary activities communicate that human days are filled with responsibilities and relationships, yet time passes quickly. The elder gestures toward the setting sun over the hills, asking that the community learn to number its days and gain a heart of wisdom. The visual tone should be contemplative and balanced, showing mortality without grim imagery. Authentic ancient Israelite garments, stone walls, clay lamps, and natural sunset light. No modern clocks, calendars, text, or fantasy effects.

title: Establish the Work of Our Hands
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient Israelite community works together to repair a stone wall and prepare a field after a difficult season. Men carry stones, women sort grain and prepare food for the workers, and children bring small vessels of water to older relatives. An elder pauses and raises his hands in prayer, asking God to return with compassion, satisfy the people with mercy, and establish the work of their hands. In the background, a field shows new growth after rain and the first warm sunlight reaches the repaired wall. The setting communicates that the people's labor matters even though human life is brief, and that lasting fruitfulness depends on God's favor. The scene should not imply that prayer guarantees effortless prosperity or that every hardship will immediately end. Use historically accurate agricultural tools, stonework, woven garments, and natural early-morning light. No modern construction machinery, captions, or supernatural effects.

title: He Who Dwells in the Secret Place of the Most High
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism with restrained symbolic composition, an Israelite traveler rests in the shelter of a massive rock overhang while a harsh storm passes through the surrounding wilderness. The shelter provides real protection from wind and rain. Nearby, a small bird rests beneath dense branches, and a sturdy fortress rises on a distant hill, visual symbols for the psalm's language of refuge, shield, and fortress. The traveler looks toward the sky in quiet trust, with a cloak wrapped around his shoulders. Farther along the landscape, other travelers move carefully along a safe path, while the storm remains in the distant valley. Avoid showing arrows, disease, or supernatural danger as literal attacks, and do not portray the psalm as a guarantee that faithful people never face harm. The image should evoke confidence under God's shelter amid the dangers of the world. Realistic ancient clothing, rock formations, natural weather, and muted storm light. No modern equipment, graphic scenes, or fantasy creatures.

title: Under His Wings and in His Care
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a peaceful ancient Israelite household sheltered within sturdy stone walls during a night of unsettled weather. A family rests together while a guardian remains near the doorway, attentive but calm. Outside, the wind moves branches and dust along the street, while the roof and walls offer ordinary shelter. Above a small nest beneath the eaves, a mother bird covers her young with her wings, providing a natural visual metaphor for divine protection. In the foreground, a worshipper stands by an oil lamp and prays with a confident expression, trusting that God is with those who love Him and call upon His name. The composition can include a distant path through a wilderness, where a traveler continues safely, but should not depict literal angels carrying a person in the air or physical supernatural attacks. Convey protection, companionship in trouble, deliverance, and the hope of seeing God's salvation. Historically plausible clothing, stone architecture, bird anatomy, and warm lamplight. No modern objects, text, or fantasy effects.

title: It Is Good to Give Thanks to the LORD
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient Israelite worship courtyard at the beginning of a quiet time of praise. Musicians play lyres and simple percussion instruments, while worshippers gather to give thanks in the morning and reflect on God's faithfulness at night. One elderly singer raises his face in gratitude, while another worshipper listens with eyes closed in concentration. Through an open archway, healthy olive trees and a distant field are visible in the morning light. At the edge of the courtyard, a prosperous but arrogant man moves through the town without understanding the lasting value of wisdom, symbolizing the psalm's contrast between flourishing pride and a life rooted in righteousness. Keep the portrayal moral rather than mocking any particular person. Historically plausible instruments, stone architecture, wool garments, clay lamps, and natural lighting. No modern worship equipment, printed lyrics, or fantasy effects.

title: The Righteous Flourish Like a Palm Tree
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a peaceful garden near an ancient Israelite sanctuary where a mature palm tree and a healthy cedar stand among olive trees and other local vegetation. Beside the trees, elderly worshippers gather in a shaded courtyard. One person with gray hair and a walking staff speaks with strength and gratitude, showing that the righteous can continue to bear fruit in old age. Nearby, a younger family waters a small tree and tends the soil, suggesting the continuity of faithful life across generations. In the background, arrogant people who once boasted of temporary success are represented by an empty courtyard and neglected possessions, while the healthy trees remain rooted and flourishing. The scene should visualize the psalm's claim that the LORD is upright, a rock without unrighteousness, and that those planted in His house continue to praise Him. Use realistic palm and cedar anatomy, ancient stonework, authentic garments, and natural sunlight. No modern gardening equipment, text, or fantasy effects.

title: The LORD Reigns, Clothed with Majesty
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism with majestic natural imagery. A broad coastal landscape in the ancient Near East shows powerful waves breaking against rocky cliffs beneath a vast sky. The sea is turbulent but remains within its natural boundaries, while distant mountains rise behind the shoreline. On a rocky promontory, several Israelite worshippers stand in awe and gratitude, acknowledging the LORD's majesty, strength, and established rule. Inland, a fortified city remains firm above the waters, symbolizing the stability of God's dominion. A sanctuary courtyard can be glimpsed in the distance, where elders gather to reflect on God's testimonies and holiness. Do not depict God as a human monarch standing in the clouds or suggest that the sea itself is a supernatural monster; the water is a natural expression of the psalm's poetry about roaring floods and the LORD being mightier than their noise. Use realistic waves, stone cliffs, ancient garments, and natural light. No modern seawalls, ships, text, or fantasy effects.
